_note: Without a Svelte config the language server transpiles each <script lang="ts"> before compiling, so only what TypeScript's ES-next output keeps (decorators, accessor fields) can fail there; a script without lang in a TypeScript component is compiled as TypeScript untranspiled and its enum fails. The template is checked before the instance script, which is checked before the module script. Type-only namespaces and declare global pass. Verified against svelte-check 4.4.6.
